name: Akiko Global Services Ltd.
summary: Akiko Global Services Ltd. operates as a specialized financial services intermediary in India, primarily focusing on the distribution of retail financial products. The company serves as a channel partner for major banks and Non-Banking Financial Companies (NBFCs), facilitating the distribution of credit cards, personal loans, business loans, home loans, and loans against property to retail customers. Its operations leverage a proprietary digital platform, referred to as The Money Office or The Money Fair, which streamlines application processes, lead generation, customer profiling, and credit assessment through algorithmic analysis. Akiko Global Services employs a commission-based business model, generating revenue from financial institutions for successfully sanctioned financial products. The company's industry focus is within the banking and financial auxiliary services sector in India.
